description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFieldText class, a component of the SuiteCRM system that handles the display and editing of text fields in the CRM's user interface. It includes methods for rendering detail views, editing views (including rich text with TinyMCE), and setup routines for initializing editor configurations.

classes.name: SugarFieldText
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase that manages the rendering and setup of text fields, including support for rich text editing with TinyMCE within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares display parameters and calls the parent method to render detailed views of the text field.

methods.name: getClassicEditView
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML for editing the text field, supporting rich text editing if enabled.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the field, including configuring TinyMCE for rich text editing when applicable.
